hypothesis: The distribution of observable gap levels and context differs between synthetic training and requests. Unsupervised density-ratio fitting can adapt V7's linear response without learning a new count predictor.
classifier: Standardized logistic regression, C=1, balanced classes, max_iter=300, seed=6104
features: level, gap geometry, own candidate deviations, partner deviations and availability; no labels, dates or V7 estimates
selection: Same source-recording development gate before any new assessment
limitation: Earlier fixed/mirror failures informed this hypothesis; subsequent evaluation is exploratory, not fresh independent validation.
